visual.name: erpKpiCard
visual.description: Animated KPI card: count-up headline, comparison badge (vs target or prior year) and a self-drawing sparkline with hover readout. Animations by GSAP.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional. A period column such as Date[Year Month]. Draws the sparkline; the headline shows the latest period with data.

dataRoles.name: value
dataRoles.description: The KPI measure shown as the headline number.

dataRoles.name: comparison
dataRoles.description: Optional. Target, budget or prior-year measure. Drives the change badge.

dataRoles.name: headline
dataRoles.description: Optional. A measure that returns the whole-period value (e.g. CALCULATE([Margin %], ALLSELECTED('Date'))). When set, it replaces the headline number; the sparkline still uses Value.
